item.title: Ishan, Yadav dismantle New Zealand
item.description: (ESPNCRICINFO) – Ishan Kishan and Suryakumar Yadav showed what modern T20 batters are capable of. In the second T20I against New Zealand in Raipur, Kishan smashed 76 off 32 balls and Suryakumar 82 not out off 37 to help India complete a chase of 209 in just 15.2 overs.
